faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the susceptibility of TB bacteria to rifabutin, an antibiotic used in TB treatment.

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin done?
faqs.answer: • To identify drug-resistant strains of TB bacteria • To guide appropriate treatment options for TB • To assess the effectiveness of rifabutin in treating TB • To monitor the progress of TB treatment and adjust medication if necessary

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for individuals who are diagnosed with TB or suspected to have drug-resistant strains of TB. It is also used to guide treatment decisions for patients who may have been exposed to someone with TB or have symptoms suggestive of TB.

faqs.question: What if the results of AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results indicate resistance of the TB bacteria to rifabutin or other drugs used in TB treatment.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin?
faqs.answer: During this test, your healthcare provider will collect a specimen of pure culture (Mtb Complex) from a bottle or MGIT tube or LJ slant. The specimen will be sent to the laboratory for testing using the MGIT method.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin?
faqs.answer: • Follow any specific instructions given by your healthcare provider regarding fasting, medications, or other preparations. • Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin?
faqs.answer: • AFB smear to detect the presence of TB bacteria in a sputum sample • Culture and sensitivity testing to identify the bacteria causing TB and determine its susceptibility to various anti-TB drugs • Xpert MTB/RIF assay for rapid detection of TB DNA and evaluation of rifampicin resistance

faqs.question: What is AFB (TB) Antibiogram - Rifabutin also known as?
faqs.answer: TB Drug Susceptibility Testing for Rifabutin

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacteria. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. TB is transmitted through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes.
